equipment_type: Boiler operating controller (RWF40) via ProtoNode gateway
applies_to: Thermal Solutions EVA, EVAW, EVO and EVOW boilers whose operating control is an RWF40, connected through a ProtoNode FPC-N34.
summary: Thermal Solutions EVA/EVAW/EVO/EVOW boilers expose their RWF40 controller to BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP through a ProtoNode FPC-N34 gateway that polls it over Modbus RTU. The RWF40 profile has 15 objects: three analog inputs, setpoint and mode readbacks, and writable process enable, process setpoint, relay enables, step control and modulation values.
default_device_instance: 50000 + the controller's Modbus Node-ID (Node_Offset default 50,000, changeable in the Web Configurator)
notes: Each connected controller shows up as its own BACnet device on the ProtoNode FPC-N34 gateway.
The table has no read/write column; access here is inferred from the LonWorks direction (nvi = writable) in the same table.
The guide gives no engineering units or value ranges; units follow the controller's own configuration.
The same ProtoNode can also carry the burner's RM7800 flame safeguard and an RWF55 controller; those have separate lists.

integration.summary: Wire the RWF40 Modbus port to the ProtoNode, set the RWF40 to 19200 8N1 with a unique Node-ID, add the RWF40 profile in the Web Configurator, then discover the device at 50000 + Node-ID. The writable objects are Process Enable, Process Setpoint, the K1/K2/K3/K6 enables, Step Control and Modulation; the guide does not describe how the boiler uses them.

integration.enable: The guide lists BV 7 Process Enable and AV 8 Process Setpoint as writable but gives no procedure for handing control to the BMS; check the RWF40 configuration.
setup: Device instance = Node_Offset (default 50,000) + the controller's Modbus Node-ID, so Node-ID 1 gives 50001.
ProtoNode default IP is 192.168.1.24 (255.255.255.0); change it in the FS-GUI under Setup > Network Settings.
FPC-N34 S-bank DIP switches pick the protocol: all Off = BACnet IP, S0 On = BACnet MS/TP, S2 On = BACnet MS/TP single node.
BACnet MS/TP: one MAC address (1-127) for the whole ProtoNode on A-bank DIP switches; baud on B-bank switches, factory default 38400.
Modbus side: every RWF40, RWF55 and RM7800 must run Modbus RTU at 19200, 8N1 with a unique Node-ID (1-255); add each one as a profile in the Web Configurator.
With more than one controller on a ProtoNode set BACnet Virtual Server Nodes to Yes; give each ProtoNode on a subnet its own BACnet Network Number (default 50).
gotchas: Points have no units in the guide; scale and units depend on how the RWF40 is configured.
Access is inferred from the LonWorks names: AV 4-6 and the analog inputs are read-only outputs, AV/BV 7-14 are writable.
RWF40 wiring: CA to ProtoNode Tx+, CB to Rx-, CG to GND.
